notes: The first route runs Mubarak, Thabit, Anas; the questioner «أن رجلا» is in the scene, not a link
The second isnad after the matn («حدثنا بذلك») carries the same saying and is a route of its own; its «بهذا» closes it back to the first chain
The compiler's teacher «أبو داود سليمان بن الأشعث» is written in the text and kept as a narrator
